title: Sharing a chosen value with gentle courage

captions.energy: Choosing a value you both cherish

meaning: A freely chosen shared value can inspire you when passing on experience brings calm courage to participate.
text: Passing on something valued becomes easier when you both choose this particular endeavour. The Lovers in the energy of Sahasrara support free agreement around a purpose close to you. The Hierophant in the physical position describes shared actions: learning within a chosen tradition, explaining foundations and sharing experience with others. Strength in emotions brings gentle courage to remain with the unfamiliar without pressure. It feels rewarding that a chosen value already continues among people. Your participation need not prove its importance through force; understandable transmission can leave someone else a genuine attempt of their own.

For example, you demonstrate an old hand-weaving technique to beginners together. A knot does not work immediately, so you calmly return to its foundation instead of finishing the work for someone. **A shared choice becomes living support through gentle transmission.** Gradually, another pair of hands finds the movement, bringing you warm courage to continue. Knowledge already extends beyond a familiar circle: someone can make an object independently and pass the method further without repeating your gathering word for word.

The difficulty may arise if the teaching role requires one correct pace. Someone needs to move more slowly, but the session continues for the programme’s sake. Free motivation and gentle courage remain supportive. Action benefits from connection with actual learning, valuing a small understandable result above the entire list of explanations you managed to deliver in one evening.
